c.v: Talk directly with our directors. No call centre, no pressure.
Can I build a duplex on my block?
It depends on your zoning, lot size and frontage. Many Sydney blocks qualify for a fast-track complying development (CDC) approval. We check your block for free.
What's the difference between CDC and DA approval?

A Complying Development Certificate (CDC) is a faster approval for designs that meet set rules. A Development Application (DA) goes through council and suits more complex designs. We advise which fits your project and manage either.
How much does it cost to build a duplex in Sydney?
It depends on size, finishes and your site. Use our estimator for a quick guide, then book a free consultation for a detailed, fixed-price quote.
Can I live in one side and rent or sell the other?
Yes. Many clients live in one home and rent or sell the other. We design both sides around your plans.
Yes. We build single and double-storey duplexes in Box, French, Modern Contemporary and Traditional Full Brick styles.
